errors.text: The proposed material is a W-Ni-Fe-Ta refractory alloy rather than the dual-phase lamellar Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic high-entropy alloy.
The intervention is a rolling and sequential-aging route, not the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment.
The proposed structural evolution to dual coherent nanoprecipitates does not reconstruct the target transition from incoherent FCC/B2 lamellae to a coherent hierarchical pattern.
The falsification experiment omits pressure-matched and temperature-matched controls and does not measure the target signatures of fracture morphology and phase-resolved GND-density convergence.
